verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's docs explicitly describe branching database schemas and data the same way as code branches, creating isolated dev/test environments from production-shaped branches (docs-9, docs-10, docs-32), corroborated by hands-on community use describing a database branch per git branch workflow (comm-9). Backups/restores and non-blocking schema deploys further support the workflow (docs-11, docs-12, docs-27). missing for 10: independent post-2021 hands-on confirmation of copy-on-write speed/isolation specifics, explicit copy-on-write terminology in docs.
